title: RE60018: Fault Diagnosis And Predictive Maintenance
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Determining health of machines through parameter monitoring. Performance and
auxiliary variables, vibration parameters, time and frequency domain signals,
vibration identification and diagnostic tables, vibration standards, vibration
monitoring instruments. Temperature monitoring, thermography, tem-plugs,
thermo-paints. Lubrication monitoring, SOAP, wear particles analysis,
ferrography, ferrographical analyzer. Noise-sound monitoring sound measurement,
magnetic tape recorders, sound level meters and analyzers, sound level data
processing.
